name: Amelia Frid
title: Clinical Psychologist & Board Approved Supervisor
description: Over 20 years with Complex PTSD and personality related vulnerabilities, attachment, and trauma and post traumatic stress disorder. Amelia specialises in trauma treatment, and complex presentations. Specialist training in DBT, CBT, ACT, Schema focused therapy and EMDR.
specialties: trauma, complex PTSD, schema therapy, EMDR, DBT, personality

name: Dean Janover
title: Psychologist (M Psych, MAPS)
description: Practising since 1999 with adults and adolescents; utilises Cognitive Behaviour Therapy, Mindfulness and Schema therapy techniques. Areas include sexual performance issues including premature ejaculation and erectile dysfunction.
specialties: schema therapy, sexual performance, sex therapy, CBT

name: Dr Irene Panagopoulos
title: Clinical and Forensic Psychologist
description: Therapeutic approaches incorporate CBT, Trauma therapy and Mindfulness. Special interest in trauma (physical, sexual and emotional) and its impact on health and wellbeing.

name: Madeline Grosso
title: Psychologist
description: Registered since 2005; special interest in trauma recovery and providing neurodiversity affirming assessments for ADHD and Autism. Draws on CBT, mindfulness, psychodynamic therapy, attachment theory, ACT and EMDR.

name: Sally Capper
title: Psychologist (Counselling Psychology)
description: Passionate about supporting individuals to process trauma. Specializing in Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), Sally integrates Attachment-Informed (AI) EMDR and Internal Family Systems (IFS) AI EMDR. Works with Trauma/PTSD or complex PTSD.

name: Sheridan Finlay
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Over 10 years across hospital, forensic and community settings with concerns including trauma; expertise in risk assessment including sexual offending. Brings a collaborative, strengths-based and trauma-informed approach.
